components.name: Slug Mortar
components.blurb: Manifest: one slug, forty kilos, delivery by air. Eats a rack of ammunition per breakfast. Grundl reload it between bites.
components.quirk: Huge kinetic hits (10, piercing a cell; +33% over a tier-3 laser), but each shot spends three scrap. Grundl restock twice as fast.

components.name: Grapple Harpoon
components.blurb: A barbed head and forty metres of chain, for towing barges and, lately, enemy ships. Needs a Grundl on the winch or it takes all day.
components.quirk: Magnetic: pulls the enemy ship toward you. Reloads at only 30% rate unless a Grundl mans it.

components.name: Barge Flak
components.blurb: Four fat banded barrels over an ammo drum. Fires everything it has at everything that moves, then asks for more.
components.quirk: A big turret flak (six heavy pellets), but it spends two scrap a volley. Grundl restock twice as fast.

components.name: Hauler Thrusters
components.blurb: Two huge bells strapped with fuel cells. Hauls like a barge tug, as long as a Grundl feeds the cells. Heavy.
components.quirk: Thrust x1.6 (29) with a Grundl in its room tending the fuel cells; without one it makes the Mk2's 18. The heavy mass cannot be set from a pack.

components.name: Freight Shield
components.blurb: A blue disc in a heavy cage with four lamps for the fuel cells. Four layers; each lamp wants a hand to refill.
components.quirk: Two layers more than a Shield Mk2 (four), but a used layer comes back only while a Grundl is in its room restocking the cells.

components.name: Cargo Deck
components.blurb: Crates, a shell rack, a hoist with a swinging hook. Room for a great deal more. Loading is hard work without a Grundl.
components.quirk: +50 hold and twice the ammo racks (data only: no hold limit exists yet), but anyone but a Grundl works x0.8 in it.
